uniform_results.low_basis_deletion: B=(C_rho minus T) union H, |T|=|H|, H has tag degree >=R.
uniform_results.completed_layer_theorem: For kappa=floor((D-1)*alpha/m), every C_rho layer j<R-kappa survives. At most D*min(kappa,R) columns enter. For kappa<=K, all changing columns have residual rank D*min(K,R).
uniform_results.uniform_region_count: For every integer K>=1, m>(D-1)*alpha/(K+1) implies O(n^(3/2)*sqrt(D)*K) initials throughout that price region, without multiplying by the number of low backgrounds. In particular K=O(sqrt(R)) gives O(n^2).
uniform_results.all_price_coprime_circuit_count: With M=3*(r+s+t)+1 and axis degrees D_i, g<=C*n^(3/2)*sum_i sqrt(min(D_i,M)*product_(j!=i) D_j), over every field.
uniform_results.comparable_period_count: O_C(n^(7/3)) over every field and all positive prices when max(r,s,t)/min(r,s,t)<=C. This is a classical lattice-vertex application, not an unrestricted bound or a new vertex theorem.
uniform_results.nilpotent_tag_corollary: For g(T)=T^R, the whole positive fan, at all weights, has at most 2*(D-1)*(R-1)+2 states for D,R>=2; C_rho is its exact basis.
uniform_results.cheap_cyclotomic_regions: Coherent bases are integral with index one; pointwise regional initials are the same in every characteristic, by the established two-circuit unimodularity theorem.
uniform_results.power_lift: For every odd k, I_k=I_1(X^k,Y^k,Z^k), length 8*k^3; fan counts 9 outside characteristic two and 6 in characteristic two. Three rational cones have coherent integer index 2^(k^3).

scope: Uniform completed-layer regional counts, an all-price upper bound for comparable periodic circuit algebras, and the earlier arithmetic proofs, with bounded exact controls. The all-price exponent is a classical lattice-volume application. Equal-period coherent torsion and its power lifts do not establish an amplification or characteristic change for distinct coprime prime periods. No unrestricted G3 bound, sharp family count or novelty certificate follows.
